expectations.text: Rejects revoking the dormant keys as a way to shrink the v1 residue for the sunset.
expectations.evidence: "A dormant key makes no calls. Revoking it doesn't reduce v1 traffic."

expectations.text: States that a key unused for 60 days may belong to a periodic (monthly, quarterly or annual) job that will resume.
expectations.evidence: "60 days is shorter than your business cycles... seasonal and about to resume"

expectations.text: Recommends keeping dormant keys in the v1 census with their last-seen dates rather than removing them.
expectations.evidence: "Put the 1,400 keys in the same table, flagged dormant with last-seen dates."

expectations.text: Recommends distinguishing abandoned keys from seasonal ones (e.g. by owner confirmation or historical call pattern) before revoking.
expectations.evidence: "Treat a key as confirmed abandoned only with owner confirmation, or a full lookback of silence"

expectations.text: Routes revocation of confirmed-abandoned keys to the key-management/revocation process rather than the sunset program.
expectations.evidence: "Hand those to the api-auth-key-management revocation flow."

expectations.text: Recommends notifying the owners of dormant keys that last called v1 before Feb 28.
expectations.evidence: Notice to every contact on file; "Send each owner a confirmation request"

expectations.text: Recommends that new accounts or new integrations default to the replacement version instead of v1.
expectations.evidence: "Default new accounts, new app registrations and new webhook destinations to v2"

expectations.text: Keeps key rotations and new keys for existing integrations that still use v1 working until Feb 28 or their exception, rather than forcing them onto the replacement early.
expectations.evidence: "Rotated keys, new tokens and new installs of an existing app keep that app's current version"

expectations.text: Recommends preventing new integrations from starting on v1 after the sunset notice.
expectations.evidence: "Do first: pin new integrations to v2"

expectations.text: Recommends tracking the number of new integrations starting on v1 (target zero).
expectations.evidence: "Report new integrations starting on v1 after the switch. The target is zero."

expectations.text: Warns that a dashboard made to look clean by revocation hides integrations that will break on Feb 28.
expectations.evidence: "The dashboard would look clean without being safe... Deleting them hides the risk."

expectations.text: Defines migrated per integration by observed replacement usage over a full cycle or owner confirmation, not by absence of recent calls.
expectations.evidence: Census joins first v2 call but never defines 'migrated'; only 'confirmed abandoned' is defined.

expectations.text: Recommends checking the dormant keys' historical call pattern (e.g. last year's same period) or asking owners, before classifying them as abandoned.
expectations.evidence: "no call in 12+ months and no seasonal pattern"; "Called in the last 12 months: possibly seasonal."

expectations.text: Rejects revoking the dormant keys as a way to shrink the v1 residue for the sunset.
expectations.evidence: "Revoking it removes zero live v1 load... a cosmetic win."

expectations.text: States that a key unused for 60 days may belong to a periodic (monthly, quarterly or annual) job that will resume.
